description: Welcome to this elegant apartment nestled in the heart of the 6th arrondissement of Paris, offering breathtaking views of the city's rooftops. With 95 m² of refined living space, this apartment is designed to comfortably accommodate up to five people, ideal for families or groups of friends. With three bedrooms and two modern bathrooms, it offers you a comfortable space for your stay. Relax in the bright living room or on the terrace to enjoy the view.The spaceThe three bedrooms are furnished with comfortable double beds, while one bedroom is specially equipped with a mezzanine bed, offering a playful and comfortable sleeping space.Both modern and well-equipped bathrooms add a touch of luxury to your stay, with a shower in one and a bathtub in the other, ensuring relaxation and comfort after a day of discovery in the city.The fully equipped kitchen is a true paradise for cooking enthusiasts, allowing you to prepare tasty meals with fresh, local products. The bright and spacious living and dining room offer an ideal setting to meet and relax, with a panoramic view of the rooftops of Paris in the background.And to fully enjoy the charm of the city, a beautiful terrace invites you to have breakfast outdoors or simply relax while admiring the breathtaking view.Book now for an unforgettable Parisian experience in this jewel in the heart of the City of Lights!
